answer: Bind reward to a live heartbeat chain: each round a public beacon emits randomness; the identity must publish a signed, memory-hard chained link within a strict deadline, etched like onyx. Weight grows only with consecutive verified beats, glacier-paced continuity. Memory contention caps the chains one machine serves concurrently, so sybil count tracks live hardware, not keys; the voyage toward cheap clones costs real rental. Limits: needs an unbiasable beacon, and per-epoch reward must stay below amortized rental.
